detail.longDescription: I’m building a character-based chat application with Next.js and PostgreSQL. Each character has relatively static data such as: personality backstory speaking style scenario character-specific instructions But I also want characters to remember information learned during conversations, for example: user's name preferences important past events relationship state promises or unfinished topics Right now I just send the last ~20 messages along with the character prompt on every request. That works for short conversations, but obviously doesn't scale to months of conversation history because of context-window limits and inference cost. I'm considering a combination of: recent messages summarized older conversation extracted long-term memories vector search for relevant memories Is this a reasonable architecture? How would you structure the database/prompting flow so old memories can be retrieved without polluting the context with irrelevant information?
